//: Type check for the build, data-pull and QA scripts: `npm run check:scripts`.
PART OF `npm run verify` since 2026-09-23. It had been left out on purpose while it
reported errors that were never bugs (a first pass found 11, and by 2026-09-23 there
were 132). All 132 were inference, not defects: the games' test hooks read inside
Playwright callbacks (96, declared once in types/test-hooks.d.ts), page code that
sees a plain Element, mixed-type array literals, untyped Promises. Each got a JSDoc
annotation, and the gate went in the day it went green, because the scripts it
covers (the phone sweep above all) are the ones that grow every week.
A gate that always fails is a gate everyone learns to ignore; this one starts clean.
